name: Concierge
description: Natural-language search for your Jellyfin library — describe a film and find it, including by the lines spoken in it.
overview: Search your library the way you'd describe a film to a friend.

versions.changelog: Phases 0 and 1: plugin skeleton, dual model profile system, local hybrid index with the enrichment pass, BM25 + vector retrieval with rank fusion, query router, and POST /Concierge/Search. Not yet exercised against a live server.
